Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

paramix 0.0.2

CRAN release: 2025-06-10

  • Extended documentation to clarify mathematical formulation of the mixing table.
  • Added package hex logo in man/figures/logo.png and configured pkgdown favicons with light/dark theme support.
  • Modernized CI pipelines migrated from imuMAP, including multi-platform R CMD check (Linux, macOS, Windows), automated linting with air and lintr, code coverage via Codecov, and automated pkgdown deployment.
  • Standardized error and warning signaling using centralized templates in R/messages.R with dedicated unit tests.
  • Integrated roxyglobals to automate global variable declarations in R/globals.R.
  • Removed generated documentation (man/*.Rd) and intermediate vignette outputs from version control, managing them as transient build products generated by just docs.
  • Added standard justfile developer workflows (format, lint, docs, install, test, coverage, site, check).
  • Cleaned up and added linting validation for demonstration analysis workflows in inst/analysis/.
  • Added dedicated vignette reproducing-paper-analysis documenting how to run the simulation study from Goodfellow et al. (2025) doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1013420, with citation metadata in DESCRIPTION and inst/CITATION.
  • Added CI action and just test-analysis workflow to verify that the bundled analysis pipeline runs and reproduces all outputs from the installed package.

Developed by Carl Pearson, Simon Proctor, Lucy Goodfellow.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1. Part of the ACCIDDA project.
